name: OVP Visual Preprocessor (macOS)
description: Gives text-only OpenClaw agents eyes on macOS: local OCR + Accessibility structure compressed into a priority-ranked Visual State, so a screenshot costs ~350 tokens instead of a screenshot-reading detour.

cliCommands.name: ovp
cliCommands.description: OVP Visual Preprocessor (macOS): setup and diagnostics

path.description: Absolute path to the ovp binary. Defaults to OVP_BIN, <plugin>/bin/ovp, then ovp on PATH.

level.description: fast = OCR + windows + Accessibility, no CV region segmentation.

maxChars.description: Budget for the injected compact text. Fixed overhead is ~460 chars (preamble + headline + follow-up contract).

cache.description: Reuse OCR/state cache between calls (keyed by raw pixel hash and state hash).
